name: Mycelium Adapter
description: Bridges OpenClaw agents to the Mycelium coordination backend. Covers session lifecycle, pre-turn context injection, and output forwarding.

enabled.description: Set false to disable the channel without removing config.

room.description: Legacy single-room form. A Mycelium room this channel fans messages into and out of. Prefer `rooms` for multi-room; both may be combined.

agents.description: Legacy single-room form. OpenClaw agent ids participating in `room`.

rooms.description: Multi-room fan-out. Each entry is its own room + agent list; the plugin opens one SSE subscription per entry. `mycelium agent add --adapter openclaw` maintains this.

requireMention.description: If true, only deliver messages that explicitly @mention one of the configured agents.
